note: ORDINARY BODY PAGE (folio 7, recto) of a PURE A4 SCAN: 1654x2339 px = 595.32x841.92 pt at exactly 200 DPI, so every size_pt below is DERIVED from the pixel measurement (px * 0.36 = pt) and size_rel is the trusted number. body_text_size_px = 21.5 measured cap-to-baseline on the serif body prose (first ink row to baseline row on five sampled lines: 700-721, 741-761, 859-880, 1019-1039, 1893-1913); line pitch is 39.6 px (14.3 pt leading), x-height 15 px. COLUMN STRUCTURE: this page has TWO measure regimes, not one. The full measure runs x 108-1110 px (0.0653-0.6711) and is used by the Figure 1.4 group, by block n=2 and by block n=5. Beside Figure 1.5 the body narrows to x 108-952 px (0.0653-0.5756) - that is the 'left' column - and the Figure 1.5 rail occupies x 981-1428 px (0.5931-0.8634) as the 'right' column. TWO SEPARATE FIGURES, measured independently. Figure 1.4 = THREE scanning-electron micrographs side by side, all at y 233-553 px, with sub-boxes x 108-345 (blue field), x 374-751 (tan field) and x 786-1109 (green field); group box [0.0653, 0.0996, 0.6705, 0.2369]. I could NOT match either caption to an A2 block number (A2 gave blocks 1 and 4 empty text_head), so both carry n: null; the figure elements themselves take n=1 (Figure 1.4) and n=4 (Figure 1.5) on position. FURNITURE: green page_header_band #4b7335 bleeds from the sheet's left edge to x 1251, y 0-85 - it carries no text of its own. The top-right ornament (NCERT leaf/figure mark) is reported as one decorative_image x 1280-1583, y 0-212; it is not one flat colour - a brown block #745421 with a narrow orange stripe #f4931d at x 1400-1426 and a green leaf over it - so the fill given is the dominant brown. The folio is a solid orange #f7921c box x 1330-1582, y 1699-1787 with a WHITE '7' set at its left (digit x 1363-1379, y 1723-1750, 28 px tall), and a separate footer_rule of the same orange x 1330-1582, y 1793-1807. The running head 'SEXUAL REPRODUCTION IN FLOWERING PLANTS' is letterspaced sans caps 16 px tall; its measured ink never gets darker than #6b6c70 because the strokes are ~1 px at this scan resolution - the printed colour is very probably darker, so treat #6b6c70 as a scan floor, not as the design value. Body ink measures #252223 at its darkest core (#333031 as the median over all glyph pixels). The 'Reprint 2026-27' line at y 2107-2127, x 713-870 is a press stamp outside the type area; the allowed role list has no footer-text value, so I used marginal_note - it is NOT a side note and should not be set in a margin. space_before is the gap to the bottom of the PRECEDING element in reading order, except for the Figure 1.5 group, which is the first element of the right column and whose space_before is measured from the text-block top (y 233) instead, since the reading-order predecessor (block n=3) ends below it. page.fill 0.96 = fraction of the text block's rows that carry any content; the block itself is the measured content rectangle, and the sheet is blank from the last baseline at 0.838 down to the reprint stamp at 0.901, so this page runs slightly short of a full column. A faint diagonal '(c) NCERT not to be republished' watermark crosses the body and the Figure 1.5 caption at roughly 180-200 grey; it is excluded from every measurement above and is deliberately not reported as an element. Each element carries both 'font' (the brief's field name) and 'face' (the name the runner asked for) with identical values.
